Our only hope is Enthir, one of Karliah and Gallus's former acquaintances who is a wizard at the College of Winterhold. | 20: Enthir has informed me that Gallus's Journal is written in Falmer. I'm left with little choice other than taking matters into my own hands and stealing his notes. | 40: Calcelmo's "notes" on the Falmer language are actually derived from a massive stone slab in his tower! I'll have to discover a way to make the information more portable. | 50 | 55 | 60 | 70 | 200: After Enthir successfully translated Gallus's journal, I've discovered that Mercer's motivations transcended simple greed or murder. According to Gallus, he defiled the temple and betrayed the Thieves Guild. Karliah insists we bring this information to Brynjolf immediately.
